title: WO planner cannot pass required visual review using text or unverified image references
steps: Run pure policy and PostgreSQL planner image/CLI regressions with scripted model replies; no provider is called.
expect: A structurally valid plan without images fails the visual policy.
Only answered delivery after an image tool call with the exact kit and catalogue hash counts.
Representative pages, kept mobile pages and every printed block need image coverage.
Strict first-user instructions replace the optional image advice; historical checker behavior is preserved.
The WO CLI freezes the policy, missing delivery fails a checked round, and actual image delivery permits the next checked round to pass.
fence: Mandatory image evidence for opt-in WO planner runs; standalone historical benches preserve their existing policy.

tests: visual review fails without delivered images and asks for group representatives first
actual answered deliveries cover representatives, kept blocks and responsive pages
tool names, forged refs and unanswered image requests never prove visual review
an incomplete image catalogue refuses coverage and historical bench checks remain unchanged
strict prompt replaces optional image advice and all printed block decisions need coverage
strict WO review follows missing image ids into a fix round and persists actual delivered evidence
strict WO review cannot pass by repeatedly returning a structurally valid plan without images
strict WO review refuses a text-only door before queueing while ordinary text benches stay available
the WO CLI visual-review flag freezes the mandatory policy on its queued run
